about: SPEC-BTUNGSTEN-PQ-1 PQ12: the official vectors bsigner's Taproot and PSBT code must reproduce, all from bitcoin/bips at one commit. Top level: BIP-341's wallet-test-vectors.json (crates/bsigner/src/taproot.rs: every intermediary hash, signature message, sighash, tweak, output key, address, control block and witness). psbt: the BIP-174 and BIP-371 texts, whose test-vector sections crates/bsigner/src/psbt.rs reads case by case. Fetched by CI job pq12-taproot at this commit, checked by size and SHA-256 (base64url, no padding) inside the tests, never committed.
